mentions.name: hallucinate.site (MMO Rave)
mentions.description: This is an MMO Rave — a shared online rave experience hosted at hallucinate.site, improved a little every day to make the experience better for attendees. The goal is to make it engaging enough that people keep returning for things beyond just the music.
mentions.problem: User numbers are still very low despite recent spikes; the project needs ways to be more engaging so people return for reasons beyond the music.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://hallucinate.site - an MMO Rave - doing little things every day and trying to improve experience for everyone.
